launch_consumer_producers_program: launch the consumer producers program with configurable number of producers
build_lp_program_topology: build a launchpad program topology with producer and consumer nodes
create_courier_node_producer: create a courier node for a producer that exposes an RPC server
create_courier_node_consumer: create a courier node for a consumer that connects to producer nodes
run_lp_program: run the launchpad program with lp.launch to start the distributed nodes
